speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome. Given the confirmed elevated urinary cortisol and your symptoms of persistent cough and shortness of breath which worsen with activity, I suspect you may be experiencing pulmonary hypertension or restrictive lung disease secondary to cortisol-induced muscle weakness or fluid retention. Do you have any history of hypertension, swelling in your legs, or easy bruising?
